observation_labels.attention_over_time: Looking at the robot for a high fraction of covered recent time; not necessarily continuously.
observation_labels.corridor_position: Position estimate is beside the robot forward corridor; future clearance is unknown.
observation_labels.current_gaze: Latest gaze sample is classified as looking at the robot.
observation_labels.face_detection: A face was detected; facing the robot is not established.
observation_labels.measured_pass_gesture: No pass gesture measurement is available.
observation_labels.measured_path_relation: Path conflict or clearance has not been measured.
observation_labels.proximity: Beyond conversation distance, within the configured social range.
observation_labels.relative_separation: Robot-person distance is decreasing; either participant may cause this.

robot.motion_description: Measured robot motion exceeds stationary tolerances; it may be translating or turning.
